purpose: Independent spot checks for disputed ChatGPT-o1/OPSIN transformations; a PubChem miss is not treated as evidence of invalidity.

queries.label: nitrotyrosine
queries.interpretation: Confirms that nitrotyrosine retains the phenolic hydroxyl. The historical OPSIN pipeline produced C9H10N2O4 nitrophenylalanine and is not equivalent.

queries.label: beta_methyltryptophan
queries.interpretation: Confirms methylation at the beta carbon and the source formula. The historical OPSIN pipeline produced a different C12H16N2O2 fused-ring structure.
